description: List a project's bookings that start between from and to (at most 92 days), earliest start first, with the person each is for. Includes cancelled and no-show bookings, so filter on status when counting visits. Follow next_cursor for the rest of the window. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page

from.description: Bookings that start at or after this time

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100; 50 if left out

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

to.description: Bookings that start before this time; at most 92 days after from

name: replo_bookings_list
title: List bookings
